Package view.gamestates

Class PlayingView

java.lang.Object
view.gamestates.PlayingView
public class PlayingView extends Object
The PlayingView class is responsible for managing and rendering the playing view of the game. It handles the drawing and updating of various game components such as buttons, overlays, and card views.
